summary: The three-tier GPT-5.6 family is generally available. Sol is the flagship, Terra balances capability and cost, and Luna targets speed and price.
summaryZh: GPT-5.6 三档模型已全面可用：Sol 面向旗舰能力，Terra 平衡能力与成本，Luna 强调速度与价格。
nextAction: Re-run one representative workload across all three tiers; compare task success and total token cost, not list price alone.
nextActionZh: 用一个代表性任务重跑三档模型；比较任务成功率与总 token 成本，而不只看单价。

summary: A cybersecurity-specific model available through the Daybreak program for approved defensive use cases.
summaryZh: 面向网络安全的专用模型，通过 Daybreak 计划向获批的防御性场景提供。
nextAction: Treat access and safeguards as part of the product surface; do not compare it as if it were an unrestricted public API.
nextActionZh: 把准入与安全控制视为产品能力的一部分；不要按无限制公共 API 来比较。

summary: These ChatGPT choices were retired; the same names may still have different API availability. Product and API lifecycle are tracked separately.
summaryZh: 这些 ChatGPT 选项已下线；同名模型的 API 可用性可能不同，因此产品端与 API 生命周期必须分开追踪。
nextAction: Audit saved prompts and Custom GPT behavior against the current GPT-5.3 / GPT-5.4 equivalents.
nextActionZh: 用当前 GPT-5.3 / GPT-5.4 对照检查已保存提示词与 Custom GPT 行为。
replacement: GPT-5.3 Instant / GPT-5.4 Thinking and Pro

summary: Still active. September 29 is an earliest-retirement commitment boundary, not an announced shutdown date.
summaryZh: 目前仍为 Active。9 月 29 日只是“不会早于此日下线”的承诺边界，并非已宣布的停服日。
nextAction: Inventory pinned model IDs now and subscribe to official deprecation notices; migrate only after a replacement is documented and tested.
nextActionZh: 现在盘点固定模型 ID 并订阅官方弃用通知；替代型号明确且测试通过后再迁移。

summary: Active today; October 15 is the current earliest-retirement commitment boundary.
summaryZh: 目前仍为 Active；10 月 15 日是当前官方承诺的最早下线边界。
nextAction: Prepare a small latency, price and quality regression suite before any lifecycle announcement lands.
nextActionZh: 在正式生命周期公告出现前，先准备小型延迟、价格与质量回归测试集。

summary: API requests to Claude Opus 4.1 no longer work; Anthropic recommends Claude Opus 4.8.
summaryZh: Claude Opus 4.1 API 已停止服务；Anthropic 推荐迁移到 Claude Opus 4.8。
nextAction: Replace the exact model ID, rerun regression evaluations and compare changed sampling-parameter behavior.
nextActionZh: 替换精确模型 ID，重跑回归评测，并检查采样参数行为变化。

summary: The latest Flash line emphasizes coding and agentic tasks. Its introductory API price is time-bounded.
summaryZh: 最新 Flash 系列强化代码与 Agent 任务；当前 API 推广价格有明确结束日期。
nextAction: Benchmark before and after removing deprecated sampling parameters; include the post-promotion price in cost projections.
nextActionZh: 移除已弃用采样参数后重新评测，并在成本预测中采用推广期结束后的价格。

summary: A stable endpoint with a documented shutdown horizon and a recommended successor.
summaryZh: 稳定端点已有明确的最早停服时间与推荐替代型号。
nextAction: Plan a controlled migration to Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite well before the earliest shutdown date.
nextActionZh: 在最早停服日期前完成到 Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite 的受控迁移。

summary: The preview endpoint has shut down; the stable Gemini Embedding 2 endpoint is the recommended replacement.
summaryZh: 预览端点已停服；官方推荐迁移到稳定版 Gemini Embedding 2。
nextAction: Re-embed a representative slice and measure retrieval drift before replacing a production vector index.
nextActionZh: 替换生产向量索引前，先对代表性样本重新嵌入并测量检索漂移。

summary: An omni world model spanning text, image, video and 3D in one spatial context, with generation, reconstruction and real-to-sim demos.
summaryZh: 在统一空间上下文中处理文本、图像、视频与 3D 的全模态世界模型，展示生成、重建与 real-to-sim 能力。
nextAction: Follow capability access separately from demo quality; weights and a general public API are not currently documented.
nextActionZh: 将能力准入与 Demo 质量分开追踪；目前尚未公开说明权重与通用 API。
